title: Quick-Roasted Mexican Bread Tacos
description: An earthy and flaky quick-fix mexican dish featuring bread, mirepoix-base, whole30-friendly ingredients cooked in a tandoor-clay-pot for a unique taco experience.

ingredients.name: 4 whole wheat tortillas (or any gluten-free bread)

instructions: Heat olive oil in a tandoor-clay-pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in lime juice. Bring to simmering point.
Fold tortillas into the pot with mirepoix mixture.
Cover tightly and roast for 10-12 minutes at a low temperature (350°F).
Add cilantro, season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot as tacos or sopes.
